parties.respondent: Commissioner Of Income Tax Bangalore and Anr.

summary: Dispute over maintainability of settlement application; leasing income taxation controversy; full and true disclosure standard; penalty immunity under s.245H; RBI guidelines vs tax compliance; High Court upheld Settlement Commission's jurisdiction; Supreme Court affirmed immunity from penalty; disclosure threshold met despite prior omissions; penalty annulled for good faith error based on regulatory guidelines.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment upheld; Settlement Commission's order confirmed; penalty annulled; immunity from prosecution granted under s.245H(1).
